messages.text: Thanks. To pull up Shop···· I need one detail that matches the order. That can be the name it ships to, the postcode, the last four digits of the phone number, or the email you used at checkout.

Got it, Dimitrios. Your Harlo B30 and the EU Power K. on order Shop···· ship together on November 15. They'll go out from our Rotterdam warehouse in the Netherlands, and the tracking link comes to your email as soon as the box leaves. You can follow the B30 stock on its way to our warehouse on the shipment status page: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Glad I could help, Dimitrios. If you were happy with the service, we'd really appreciate a review on Trustpilot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com. You're also welcome on our Discord for product news and help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

One question before you go, if you don't mind. What's the B30 going to run on once it arrives? Is it heading to a pool, or are you going solo for a block?

Solo it is. With 30 TH/s pointed at a solo pool, every share is a real shot at a whole block. Good luck with it.

Last question from me: what got you into solo mining over pooling, the jackpot itself or not wanting to hand your hashrate to a big pool?
Mining on Solar :) No point on going into a pool config.

That makes sense. With free power from the sun, the running cost drops out and the block is the only thing that matters. (address hidden) gets plenty of sun for it too.

Thanks for telling me, Dimitrios. Your B30 and Power K. ship November 15, and the tracking comes to your email when they leave Rotterdam. Happy hunting.
Cheers, Dimitrios. Enjoy the B30 when it lands.
